title: Antinous Falls (proof 03, the hall's causal map: the first death on the line)

was_the_kit_in_the_film.evidence: Takes 1-2 (films/odyssey/takes/OD-B22-S01/take1, films/odyssey/OD-B22-S01-performed) were played on the forage's card odyssey/cards/OD-B22-S01.mpd: the same roofless daylight megaron (location.megaron-hall), Antinous's table a separate staged piece ('antinous's cup and feast table', hidden in every key). odyssey/kits/locations.json lists bow-and-hall among the scene's kits, but its 'kit' was 'ithaca' and nothing of the Bow and the Hall reached the player.

assembly: the Bow and the Hall kit (tools/forage/product/kits/bow-and-hall.py @ 4eec4ad7) taken apart by film-readymades/staging_hall.py into 31 pieces on the stage (2694 parts), with the cast of the forage's card; location odyssey-od-b22-s01 (scale 0.478, centre [-100, 4, 0]); keys and plan written by tools/metis/hall.py
cause: the arrow of the contest at rest through the twelve; the archer on the sill with the doors shut behind him; the arrow loosed down the hall to Antinous at his table beyond the last axe; he falls back across it; the suitors run for the arms to the pegs by the doors and to the postern and find them bare
